questions.q: What is adolescence defined as in human development?
a: The transitional period of physical and psychological development between childhood and adulthood
The stage of infancy right after birth
The final stage of old age

questions.q: What is teenage pregnancy?
a: Pregnancy occurring in females under the age of 20 during their adolescence
Pregnancy that occurs only after marriage
A medical condition affecting elderly women

a: Interruption or dropping out of formal education
Improved social status in the community

a: Physical features that appear during puberty distinguishing males from females apart from primary sex organs
Internal organs like kidneys and liver

questions.q: Which of the following is an effective way to prevent the spread of HIV/AIDS and other STIs?
a: Practicing abstinence or using barrier methods like condoms consistently

questions.q: What is the role of the testes in the human male reproductive system?
a: To produce sperm cells and male sex hormones (testosterone)

To pump blood to the uterus
To filter liquid waste from the blood

Using harsh chemical perfumes on sensitive areas

a: They can cause severe damage to reproductive organs, chronic pain, and permanent infertility

questions.q: Which of the following agencies or groups plays a vital role in providing reproductive health education to adolescents?
a: Schools, healthcare workers, and parents/guidance counselors
